blocks.text: Oldingi darsda (→ 100-dars) ravishlarning ko'pchiligi sifat + `-ly` ekanini ko'rdik. Bu darsda — eng muhim istisnolar. Birinchidan, **good** ning ravishi — **well**. Ikkinchidan, **fast, hard, late, early** sifat ham, ravish ham bo'la oladi va `-ly` olmaydi. Uchinchidan, **lately** va **hardly** mavjud, lekin ular late va hard ning ravishi emas — **butunlay boshqa ma'noli** so'zlar. Asoslari qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 86-dars); bu yerda nozik farqlarga e'tibor beramiz.

**good** — sifat: a **good** teacher, The food is **good**. Harakat qanday bajarilganini aytish uchun ravish — **well**: She teaches **well**. Holat fe'llaridan keyin (look, sound, taste, feel) sifat kerakligini unutmang: It **sounds good**. Bundan tashqari **well** ning yana bir ma'nosi bor — sifat sifatida «**sog'lom**»: I'm not **well** (betobman), You look **well** (sog'lom ko'rinasiz). Solishtiring: You look **good** — siz chiroyli / yaxshi ko'rinasiz (kiyim, soch).

**well** bilan ko'p qo'shma sifatlar yasaladi: **well-known** (taniqli), **well-paid** (yaxshi maoshli), **well-dressed**, **well-educated**, **well-behaved** (odobli), **well-organised**, **well-informed**. Otdan oldin odatda chiziqcha bilan yoziladi (a **well-paid** job), fe'ldan keyin ko'pincha chiziqchasiz (The job is **well paid**).

items.text: Mr Brown is a **well-educated** man who speaks five languages.
items.translation: Mister Braun besh tilda gapiradigan **bilimdon** odam.

items.text: The hotel is clean and **well run**, and the staff are friendly.
items.translation: Mehmonxona toza va **yaxshi boshqariladi**, xodimlari samimiy.

items.text: Is your mother **well** now? — Yes, she's fully recovered.
items.translation: Onangiz hozir **sog'lommi**? — Ha, butunlay tuzalib ketdi.

blocks.text: fast, hard, late, early — bir xil shakl

Bu to'rt so'z sifat va ravish sifatida **bir xil**: a **fast** car — drive **fast**; **hard** work — work **hard**; a **late** train — arrive **late**; an **early** flight — get up **early**. «Fastly» degan so'z yo'q. Shu bilan birga, **lately** va **hardly** mavjud — lekin ular «kech» va «qattiq» ma'nosidagi ravish emas.
late / lately, hard / hardly — ma'no butunlay boshqa

**lately** = **recently** — «so'nggi paytlarda», ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan: Have you seen Kate **lately**? **hardly** = **almost not** — «deyarli ... emas»: I **hardly** know him (uni deyarli tanimayman). **hardly** odatda asosiy fe'ldan oldin, yordamchi va modal fe'ldan keyin turadi: I've **hardly** slept, I can **hardly** hear you. U o'zi inkor ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun yana bir inkor qo'shilmaydi: «I can't hardly» — xato.

items.text: The wind was blowing **hard**, so we stayed indoors.
items.translation: Shamol **kuchli** esayotgan edi, shuning uchun uyda qoldik.

items.text: There was **hardly** a cloud in the sky all week.
items.translation: Butun hafta osmonda **deyarli** bir parcha ham bulut **yo'q edi**.

items.text: My brother has been very moody **lately** — I don't know why.
items.translation: Akamning **keyingi paytlarda** kayfiyati tez-tez buziladi — nega ekanini bilmayman.

blocks.text: hardly any, hardly anyone, hardly ever

**hardly** ko'pincha **any**-so'zlar va **ever** bilan birga keladi va «deyarli hech ...» ma'nosini beradi. **hardly** o'zi inkor bo'lgani uchun undan keyin **no / nobody / never** emas, **any / anybody / ever** ishlatiladi: «hardly nobody» — xato, **hardly anybody** — to'g'ri.

items.text: There's **hardly anything** in the fridge — let's order a pizza.
items.translation: Muzlatkichda **deyarli hech narsa yo'q** — pitsa buyurtma qilaylik.

items.text: My grandfather **hardly ever** uses his mobile phone.
items.translation: Bobom mobil telefonidan **deyarli hech qachon** foydalanmaydi.

blocks.text: **can hardly / could hardly** + fe'l — harakatni **juda qiyinchilik bilan** bajarish: I **could hardly** breathe — **zo'rg'a** nafas olardim. Turg'un iboralar: I **can hardly wait** (sabrsizlik bilan kutyapman), I **can hardly believe** it (ishongim kelmaydi). **hardly** sifatdan oldin ham keladi: It's **hardly surprising** — Bunda ajablanarli joy yo'q.

Ma'nosi farq qiladigan yana bir nechta juftlik: **high** (baland) — **highly** (juda, yuqori darajada: **highly** recommended); **near** (yaqin) — **nearly** (deyarli: **nearly** finished); **most** (eng ko'p) — **mostly** (asosan); **short** (qisqa) — **shortly** (tez orada); **free** (tekin) — **freely** (erkin).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «She speaks English very good» → very **well**; «I work hardly every day» — bu «deyarli ishlamayman» degani! → I work **hard**; «I haven't seen him late» → **lately**; «I can't hardly hear you» → I can **hardly** hear you; «There's hardly no milk» → hardly **any** milk; «He drives fastly» → drives **fast**.

**hardly** ni doim «**deyarli ... emas / yo'q**» deb tarjima qiling. U o'zi inkor ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun gap darak shaklida qoladi: I **hardly** slept = Deyarli uxlamadim. **lately** ni esa «**recently**» bilan almashtirib tekshiring — ma'no saqlansa, to'g'ri.

examples.title: **good** or **well**?
examples.description: good — sifat (ot haqida, holat fe'llaridan keyin), well — ravish (harakat qanday bajarildi).

sentences.text: Madina is a **good** cook — her plov is famous in the whole neighbourhood.
sentences.translation: Madina **mohir** pazanda — uning palovi butun mahallaga mashhur.

sentences.text: Madina cooks **well**, but she never follows a recipe.
sentences.translation: Madina ovqatni **yaxshi** pishiradi, lekin hech qachon retseptga qaramaydi.

sentences.text: Did you sleep **well**? You look much more relaxed today.
sentences.translation: **Yaxshi** uxladingizmi? Bugun ancha xotirjam ko'rinyapsiz.

sentences.text: That's a **good** question — I'm not sure I know the answer.
sentences.translation: Bu **yaxshi** savol — javobini bilishimga ishonchim komil emas.

sentences.text: The team played **well** in the first half, but lost in the end.
sentences.translation: Jamoa birinchi bo'limda **yaxshi** o'ynadi, lekin oxirida yutqazdi.

sentences.text: Your Russian is very **good** — where did you learn it?
sentences.translation: Rus tilingiz juda **yaxshi** — qayerda o'rgangansiz?

sentences.text: Jasur speaks Russian **well**, but his writing isn't so **good**.
sentences.translation: Jasur ruschada **yaxshi** gapiradi, lekin yozishi unchalik **yaxshi** emas.

sentences.text: Everything went **well** at the interview, so I'm feeling hopeful.
sentences.translation: Suhbatda hammasi **yaxshi** o'tdi, shuning uchun umidim bor.

sentences.text: This new machine in the office makes really **good** coffee.
sentences.translation: Ofisdagi bu yangi mashina juda **mazali** qahva tayyorlaydi.

sentences.text: How **well** do you know the people you work with?
sentences.translation: Birga ishlaydigan odamlaringizni qanchalik **yaxshi** bilasiz?

examples.title: **well** = healthy; **well-known**, **well-paid**
examples.description: well sifat sifatida — «sog'lom». well bilan qo'shma sifatlar: well-known, well-paid, well-behaved, well organised.

sentences.text: I'm not feeling **well** today, so I'm going to stay at home.
sentences.translation: Bugun **mazam yo'q**, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.

sentences.text: You look **well** — the holiday has obviously done you good!
sentences.translation: **Sog'lom ko'rinyapsiz** — ta'til sizga foyda qilgani aniq!

sentences.text: Is your grandmother **well** enough to travel to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Buvingiz Toshkentga borish uchun yetarlicha **sog'ayib qoldimi**?

sentences.text: Samarkand is **well known** for its blue domes and ancient madrasas.
sentences.translation: Samarqand moviy gumbazlari va qadimiy madrasalari bilan **mashhur**.

sentences.text: Aziz has a **well-paid** job in an IT company in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz Toshkentdagi IT kompaniyada **yaxshi maoshli** ishda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Their children are always polite and **well-behaved**.
sentences.translation: Ularning bolalari doim xushmuomala va **odobli**.

sentences.text: The festival was **well organised**, and everything started on time.
sentences.translation: Festival **yaxshi tashkil qilingan** edi, hammasi o'z vaqtida boshlandi.

sentences.text: Oliver is a **well-known** journalist who writes about Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Oliver — Markaziy Osiyo haqida yozadigan **taniqli** jurnalist.

sentences.text: As always, she was elegant and **well dressed**.
sentences.translation: U har doimgidek nafis va **didli kiyingan** edi.

sentences.text: Get **well** soon! We all miss you at the office.
sentences.translation: **Tezroq tuzalib keting**! Ofisda hammamiz sizni sog'indik.

examples.title: **fast**, **hard**, **early**: no -ly
examples.description: fast, hard, early (va late) — sifat ham, ravish ham, shakli bir xil. «fastly» yo'q.

sentences.text: Bekzod drives too **fast**, especially on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, ayniqsa avtomagistralda, haddan tashqari **tez** haydaydi.

sentences.text: We took the **fast** train to Samarkand — it only takes two hours.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga **tezyurar** poyezdda bordik — atigi ikki soat ketadi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza worked **hard** all year and got a scholarship to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yil bo'yi **tirishib** o'qidi va Oksfordga grant yutib oldi.

sentences.text: Being a nurse is **hard** work, but it's very rewarding.
sentences.translation: Hamshiralik — **og'ir** ish, lekin juda ko'p mamnuniyat beradi.

sentences.text: It was snowing **hard** when we left the house.
sentences.translation: Uydan chiqqanimizda qor **qalin** yog'ayotgan edi.

sentences.text: I have to get up **early** tomorrow because my flight is at seven.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **erta** turishim kerak, chunki reysim soat yettida.

sentences.text: We caught an **early** flight, so we had the whole day in Istanbul.
sentences.translation: **Ertalabki** reysga chiqdik, shuning uchun Istanbulda butun kunimiz bor edi.

sentences.text: Don't speak so **fast** — I can't follow you.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik **tez** gapirmang — sizga yetib ololmayapman.

sentences.text: Try **hard** to remember where you left the keys.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarni qayerda qoldirganingizni eslashga **astoydil** harakat qiling.

sentences.text: Is the internet here **fast** enough to watch films online?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda internet onlayn film ko'rishga yetarlicha **tezmi**?

examples.title: **late** and **lately**
examples.description: late — kech (sifat va ravish), lately — so'nggi paytlarda (= recently), ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan.

sentences.text: The train arrived forty minutes **late** because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Qor sababli poyezd qirq daqiqa **kechikib** keldi.

sentences.text: Have you seen Kate **lately**? I haven't heard from her for weeks.
sentences.translation: **So'nggi paytlarda** Keytni ko'rdingmi? Haftalardan beri undan darak yo'q.

sentences.text: I've been sleeping badly **lately** because of stress at work.
sentences.translation: **Keyingi paytlarda** ishdagi stress tufayli yomon uxlayapman.

sentences.text: We stayed up **late** watching the football.
sentences.translation: Futbol ko'rib, **kechgacha** uxlamadik.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm **late** — the bus broke down on the way.
sentences.translation: **Kechikkanim** uchun uzr — avtobus yo'lda buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: What have you been doing **lately**? You look really happy.
sentences.translation: **Oxirgi paytlarda** nima qilyapsiz? Juda baxtli ko'rinyapsiz.

sentences.text: Prices have gone up a lot **lately**, especially for fruit and vegetables.
sentences.translation: **Keyingi vaqtlarda** narxlar, ayniqsa meva-sabzavotga, ancha oshdi.

sentences.text: In **late** spring the hills around Fergana are covered in flowers.
sentences.translation: Bahor **oxirida** Farg'ona atrofidagi tepaliklar gulga burkanadi.

sentences.text: Jasur often works **late**, so his family rarely sees him in the evening.
sentences.translation: Jasur tez-tez **kechgacha** ishlaydi, shuning uchun oilasi uni kechqurunlari kam ko'radi.

sentences.text: Has anything interesting happened at work **lately**?
sentences.translation: **Yaqin kunlarda** ishda biror qiziq voqea bo'ldimi?

examples.title: **hard** and **hardly**
examples.description: hard — qattiq, tirishib; hardly — deyarli ... emas. Ma'nosi deyarli qarama-qarshi!

sentences.text: Nilufar works **hard** — she's always the last to leave the office.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **ko'p mehnat qiladi** — ofisdan doim oxirgi bo'lib chiqadi.

sentences.text: Her lazy brother, on the other hand, **hardly** works at all.
sentences.translation: Uning dangasa akasi esa **deyarli ishlamaydi**.

sentences.text: I **hardly** know my neighbours, although we've lived here for two years.
sentences.translation: Ikki yildan beri shu yerda yashasak ham, qo'shnilarimni **deyarli tanimayman**.

sentences.text: Think **hard** before you sign the contract.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldin **yaxshilab** o'ylab ko'ring.

sentences.text: We've **hardly** started the project, and we're already behind schedule.
sentences.translation: Loyihani **deyarli boshlamadik**, lekin allaqachon rejadan orqada qolyapmiz.

sentences.text: It was raining so **hard** that the match was stopped.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir shunchalik **kuchli** yog'diki, o'yin to'xtatildi.

sentences.text: Aziz **hardly** said a word during dinner — is something wrong?
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat paytida Aziz **deyarli bir og'iz ham gapirmadi** — biror gap bormi?

sentences.text: The baby **hardly** slept last night, so we're exhausted.
sentences.translation: Kecha chaqaloq **deyarli uxlamadi**, shuning uchun holdan toyganmiz.

sentences.text: Don't be so **hard** on yourself — everyone makes mistakes.
sentences.translation: O'zingizga bunchalik **qattiqqo'l** bo'lmang — hamma xato qiladi.

sentences.text: It's **hardly** surprising that he failed — he never studied.
sentences.translation: U yiqilgani **ajablanarli emas** — hech qachon o'qimagan.

examples.title: **hardly any**, **hardly anyone**, **hardly ever**
examples.description: hardly + any / anyone / anything / anywhere / ever = «deyarli hech ...». no / nobody / never ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: There's **hardly any** petrol left — we need to stop soon.
sentences.translation: Benzin **deyarli qolmadi** — tez orada to'xtashimiz kerak.

sentences.text: **Hardly anyone** came to the meeting because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Qor tufayli yig'ilishga **deyarli hech kim** kelmadi.

sentences.text: I **hardly ever** watch TV these days — I use my phone instead.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda televizorni **deyarli hech qachon** ko'rmayman — o'rniga telefondan foydalanaman.

sentences.text: Sarah ate **hardly anything** at the party.
sentences.translation: Sara ziyofatda **deyarli hech narsa** yemadi.

sentences.text: In January there were **hardly any** tourists in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Yanvarda Xivada sayyohlar **deyarli yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Since the baby was born, we've **hardly ever** been out in the evening.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq tug'ilganidan beri kechqurunlari **deyarli hech qachon** tashqariga chiqmadik.

sentences.text: There's **hardly anywhere** to park in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida mashina qo'yishga **deyarli joy yo'q**.

sentences.text: **Hardly anybody** in my class knew the answer.
sentences.translation: Sinfimda javobni **deyarli hech kim** bilmasdi.

sentences.text: Oliver **hardly ever** calls his parents, which makes his mother sad.
sentences.translation: Oliver ota-onasiga **deyarli hech qachon** qo'ng'iroq qilmaydi — bu onasini xafa qiladi.

sentences.text: I've got **hardly any** money until payday, so let's eat at home.
sentences.translation: Maosh kunigacha **deyarli pulim yo'q**, shuning uchun uyda ovqatlanaylik.

examples.title: **can hardly**, **could hardly**: only with difficulty
examples.description: can / could hardly + fe'l — «zo'rg'a», katta qiyinchilik bilan. can hardly wait, can hardly believe — turg'un iboralar.

sentences.text: I **can hardly** hear you — the music is too loud.
sentences.translation: Sizni **zo'rg'a eshityapman** — musiqa juda baland.

sentences.text: We **can hardly** wait for the summer holidays!
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'tilni **sabrsizlik bilan kutyapmiz**!

sentences.text: After the long walk, Grandpa **could hardly** stand.
sentences.translation: Uzoq sayrdan keyin bobom **zo'rg'a oyoqda turardi**.

sentences.text: The ink on the old letter had faded so much that I **could hardly** read it.
sentences.translation: Eski xatdagi siyoh shunchalik o'chib ketgan ediki, uni **zo'rg'a o'qidim**.

sentences.text: Emma was so nervous that she **could hardly** speak.
sentences.translation: Emma shunchalik hayajonlandiki, **zo'rg'a gapirdi**.

sentences.text: I **can hardly** believe it's been ten years since we finished school!
sentences.translation: Maktabni bitirganimizga o'n yil bo'lganiga **ishongim kelmaydi**!

sentences.text: The room was so dark that we **could hardly** see each other.
sentences.translation: Xona shunchalik qorong'i ediki, bir-birimizni **zo'rg'a ko'rardik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **could hardly** keep his eyes open during the lecture.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza paytida Bekzod ko'zlarini **zo'rg'a ochiq tutib turdi**.

sentences.text: With all this noise, you **can hardly** blame them for complaining.
sentences.translation: Shuncha shovqin bo'lsa, ularni shikoyat qilgani uchun **ayblab bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: My hands were so cold that I **could hardly** hold the pen.
sentences.translation: Qo'llarim shunchalik muzlagan ediki, ruchkani **zo'rg'a ushlab turdim**.

examples.title: Mixed: **well**, **hard**, **lately**, **hardly**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: good / well, hard / hardly, late / lately, fast, early — kundalik vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: Tom has been working **hard** **lately**, so he **hardly** sees his kids.
sentences.translation: Tom **keyingi paytlarda** **qattiq** ishlayapti, shuning uchun bolalarini **deyarli ko'rmaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza did really **well** in her exams, so her parents bought her a laptop.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza imtihonlarini juda **yaxshi** topshirdi, shuning uchun ota-onasi unga noutbuk olib berishdi.

sentences.text: The bus was **late** again, and there were **hardly any** seats.
sentences.translation: Avtobus yana **kechikdi**, ichida esa o'rindiq **deyarli yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Is your father **well**? I heard he was in hospital.
sentences.translation: Otangiz **sog'-salomatmi**? Kasalxonada yotganini eshitdim.

sentences.text: I **hardly ever** drink coffee, but today I really need one.
sentences.translation: Men **deyarli hech qachon** qahva ichmayman, lekin bugun juda kerak.

sentences.text: Sarah got up **early**, worked **hard** all morning and finished the report by lunch.
sentences.translation: Sara **erta** turdi, ertalab bo'yi **tinmay** ishladi va hisobotni tushlikkacha tugatdi.

sentences.text: This is a **well-known** restaurant, but the service has been terrible **lately**.
sentences.translation: Bu **mashhur** restoran, lekin **so'nggi paytlarda** xizmat dahshatli bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Jasur runs really **fast**, even though he **hardly** trains at all.
sentences.translation: Jasur juda **tez** yuguradi, vaholanki **deyarli** mashq qilmaydi.

sentences.text: Our new manager speaks English **well**, but **hardly anyone** understands his jokes.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejerimiz ingliz tilida **yaxshi** gapiradi, lekin uning hazillarini **deyarli hech kim** tushunmaydi.

sentences.text: Sorry I got home so **late** — I **could hardly** find a taxi.
sentences.translation: Uyga juda **kech** kelganim uchun uzr — taksini **zo'rg'a** topdim.
